articles.summary: Burke & Herbert Bank is accepting submissions for its 2024-25 Lights, Camera, Save! video contest until December 1. Teens, 13-18 years old, can win cash prizes, including a top prize of $5,000 by creating a 30-second video promoting wise money management.
articles.title: Call for Entries: Burke & Herbert Bank Launches Teen Video Contest
